task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.

TEMP_ZONE is a suitable location to temporarily store the removed obstacle
CAR can reach FRONT_CRATE without initial navigation since it is within interaction_distance
